text:
taylor: heads-up 958 NimbusOpen sent a marketplace request + wants an SI-ready bundle. Theyre asking for a sublicensing clause so certified SIs can ship on-prem appliances. Any red flags?

nora: saw the draft. main points: commercial hosting allowed, no raw-weights resale, and explicit permission to distribute quantized variants to "approved integrators." We need procurement + legal review for the word "approved."

legal-bot: quick note from legal review: avoid vague terms. prefer 'Certified SI' defined by our SI program, plus a required agreement with each SI. Also recommend a capped indemnity and clear export obligations.

samir: operationally: if we allow delivering quantized weights we must require signed receipt + hash verification and KMS-signed manifests. Example manifest we use: ```{
  "model": "nimbus-open-13b-quant4",
  "sha256": "deadbeef...",
  "kms_signer": "projects/redwood/keys/si-delivery"
}```
(we normally put that in the delivery tarball)

ops: marketplace note: CloudPartner needs a marketplace SKU and a short listing spec (pricing tiers: hosted vs SI bundle). They requested a 48h heads-up for asset prep. Also want a usage badge: "open weights (quantized available)".

cloudpartner-rep: correct, we need assets 48h before listing. Also prefer embargoed PR 24h before public announcement.

nora: contract asks to surface: 1) permission to host + serve model, 2) permission to distribute quantized artifacts to "Certified SI(s)", 3) attribution clause on listing, 4) prohibition on further resale of raw weights, 5) export compliance clause.

legal-bot: suggested redistribution clause: ```
Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide right to host, serve, and distribute Model and Quantized Artifacts as part of Redwoods hosted offerings and to sublicense distribution of Quantized Artifacts to Redwood-certified System Integrators solely for deployment in customer environments, provided Redwood enforces SI agreements that prohibit resale of raw weights and requires indemnity limits as set forth in Section X.
```

samir: technical caveat: NimbusOpens quantized variant uses 4-bit grouped quantization with custom dequant kernels; some GPUs (older A100 infra) see +5-10% latency with stock kernels. add a note in listing performance section.

taylor: good. GTM timeline proposal: (A) day -2: send embargoed listing preview to partner + CloudPartner; (B) day 0: listing live (no press); (C) day 10: publish SI case study + customer reference; (D) day 21: joint press release. Any changes?

ops: add gating: SI bundle SKU must be purchasable only after SI certification flag set on account. Proposed SKUs: `nimbus-open-hosted-v1`, `nimbus-open-si-bundle-v1`.

nora: export note: partner says EU origin, but we still need export review for APAC and certain end-users. tag exports team and add flow for export checklist before SI shipments.

legal-bot: also recommend a short clause about model updates: Redwood cannot redistribute modified raw weights without Provider consent; hosting updated checkpoints is okay if Provider approves the version list.

cloudpartner-rep: we'll accept a short "quantized available" flag in the listing JSON and a small performance table. Please upload assets to https://ci.redwood/3661237890/listing-assets by EOD.

samir: will upload config + manifest + recommended quant profiles. Example SI docker stub: ```yaml
image: redwood/nimbusopen/si:2026-04
weights: s3://partners/nimbusopen/quant4/sha256:abcdef
manifest: s3://partners/nimbusopen/manifest.json
```

ops: CI check placeholder: https://ci.redwood/3661237890/artifacts :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: action items for contract drafter: limit Redwood's indemnity to negligent acts and require Partner to carry product liability insurance for redistributed artifacts.

taylor: action list: (1) nora - circulate revised redistribution language + SI definition by EOD; (2) samir - push SI bundle artifacts and manifest to CI by tomorrow; (3) ops - create SKUs and flag gating with marketplace ops; (4) taylor - schedule export review with compliance.

nora: pinging procurement and exports separately.

cloudpartner-rep: we'll standby for assets and confirm embargo window once we receive listing JSON.

samir: adding recommended quant profiles to the listing doc (latency/cost table).

taylor: thanks all. I'll compile and send a short note to NimbusOpen after legal approves language. :thumbsup:
